label: V6.4.140 - DESKTOP FIELD SAFE
notes: Root desktop/form-field fix. The global overlay normalizer now special-cases desktop My Flight so it no longer overwrites the sidebar workspace position with inline full-screen styles. Generic runtime form fields and bound inputs/check controls are explicitly protected from dark shell styling while preserving transparent paper overlays and readable black text. Retains balanced V6.4.88-style two-row desktop action geometry with the new UI visual language.
message: V6.4.140: sửa gốc My Flight PC bị overlay ép full-screen và field biểu mẫu bị bôi đen; giữ bố cục nút cân đối kiểu V6.4.88 với UI mới.
